caption_L1: Here a is a bar chart titled Total number of magnet schools in the United States from 2000/01 to 2017/18. The y-axis measures Year. On the x-axis, Number of magnet schools is plotted as a linear scale from 0 to 3,500.
caption_L2L3: Between 2000 and 2009 the number of schools increased from just under 1500 to 3000. There was a drop to 2200 in 2009/2020. Over the next 3 years there was an increase to 3100. The numbers stayed comparatively stable with small increases until 2016/2017. In 2016/2017 the numbers dropped back to 3100. In 2017/2018 the number of schools reached their highest level at 3400.
